description: API key secrets returned on create are plain strings in the spec, so they surface as `string` and leak into logs and traces. Mark them `x-sensitive` so they decode as `Redacted`: the service-account key returned by createProjectServiceAccount (ProjectServiceAccountApiKey.value) and createServiceAccountApiKey (ServiceAccountApiKeyBody.value — "The unredacted API key value."), and the admin key returned by createAdminApiKey (AdminApiKeyCreateResponse.value — "Only shown on create.").
